desc:
Universal Piano Hub is a multiplayer piano game: learn and play real songs on computer, phone, tablet and now VR!

🎯 The best Practice Mode on Roblox: follow the glowing keys, see every mistake, learn any song note by note
📚 Write and publish your own sheets, or play the ones other players made
🥽 NEW: VR! A real-size piano in front of you: press the keys with your controllers, chords too
🎤 Podiums: play a grand piano in the spotlight
🎧 Autoplay any sheet to hear how it goes
🏆 Climb the Pianist Rating leaderboard, Easy to Impossible
🎻 90 sounds, with 22 high-quality pianos: grands, felt, uprights and more
🎹 Piano or real computer keyboard view, sound effects, 11 themes
🔒 Private rooms with a password and voice chat
📱 On phones: scroll the piano or open two at once

New here? A short tour shows you everything!

Samples: Salamander Grand by A. Holm (CC BY 3.0), Headroom Piano by B. Nilsson (CC BY 4.0), E-Pianos by G. Sullivan (CC BY 3.0).
